title: aconitum napellus subsp. neomontanum
intro: Aconitum napellus subsp. neomontanum, commonly known as Monk's Hood, is a subspecies of the Aconitum napellus plant, a perennial herb native to mountainous regions. This plant has been traditionally used in medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Aconitum napellus subsp. neomontanum include pain relief, reduction of inflammation, and modulation of the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, such as aconitine, aconitidine, and napelline, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
